cd /home/runner/workspace/ai-agent
node - <<'NODE'
const fs=require('node:fs');
const patches=[
  ['backend/extension/3D_viewer.js',''],
  ['backend/extension/3D_viewer.test.js','']
];
for(const [file,b64] of patches) {
  if(!fs.existsSync(file)) throw Error('3D module missing: '+file);
  if(file.endsWith('/3D_viewer.js')&&!fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8').includes('Frontend3DViewer')) throw Error('3D module signature mismatch');
  const next=Buffer.from(b64,'base64').toString('utf8');
  fs.writeFileSync(file,next);
  console.log('3D_POSITION_FIX_WRITTEN',file,next.length);
}
const html=fs.readFileSync('frontend/index.html','utf8');
if(!html.includes('src="/extension/3D_viewer.js"')) throw Error('3D script not mounted in frontend');
console.log('3D_POSITION_FIX_MOUNT_OK');
NODE
node --check backend/extension/3D_viewer.js
node backend/extension/3D_viewer.test.js
